title: Kitchen rota — residence, Michaelmas
fictional_source: The corkboard by the common room door
summary: The second mundane one, and the only document in the game that is not from the archive. It is a piece of paper on a corkboard with four people's handwriting on it, and it is here because the document viewer should be able to hold something that is simply part of living here.

blocks.text: THIS IS NOT A KITCHEN. It is a kettle and a sink. Please do not attempt to cook. The toaster is Priya's and she has said yes but she means yes to toast.
Thu is blank because Mara does Thu. Somebody write it down. — J.
